card.name: "As" before measured-by phrases
card.fires_on: The word "as" right after a clinical finding, when it begins a phrase such as "as measured by", "as evidenced by" or "as assessed by" and names a lab marker or test.

modes.label: As measured by
modes.description: "as" after an effect or result, introducing the lab value or test used to measure it.
modes.example: There was no significant difference in the pharmacodynamic effect of warfarin administered alone and warfarin administered with Etodolac Tablets<< as>> measured by prothrombin time.

modes.label: As evidenced or indicated by
modes.description: "as" after a clinical change, introducing the sign or marker that shows it.
modes.example: If progressive renal impairment becomes evident,<< as>> indicated by increased blood urea nitrogen,

card.writes: It promotes verbs like measured, evidenced, indicated, characterized and identified, which usually follow "as" here.
card.plain: It marks the word "as" that leads into "as measured by" or "as shown by" a lab test.
